text:
anya: Opening a coordinated docs move: /docs/reference -> /docs/rest-api across 5 PRs. Main concerns: redirect coverage, search reindex timing, and short GA spike monitoring. Need review owners and a merge window.

matt: Paste PRs + preview links and let's draft the merge plan. We should also decide if we want a canary rollout (5% traffic) for the first hour.

anya: PRs: #4108 (nav/index rename), #4109 (auth), #4110 (endpoints list), #4111 (sdk-snippets), #4112 (redirects+rewrite). Previews: https://deploy-preview-4108--docs.redwood.example.com, etc.

jordan: Suggest merge order: 4108 -> 4112 -> 4109/4110 -> 4111. Make 4112 include wildcard redirects + alias anchors. We'll run search reindex after 4108+4112 are live.

lee: I'll own 4112. Planning to add Netlify _redirects and a small client-side mapping for old anchors. Example:```
# _redirects
/docs/reference/* /docs/rest-api/:splat 301!
```
Client JS alias example:```js
const anchorMap = { '#auth-flow': '#authentication' };
if (anchorMap[window.location.hash]) location.replace(anchorMap[window.location.hash]);
```

matt: Good idea. For CI gating, require: docs-preview job green, doc-lint job green, linkinator < 5 broken links. Also need 2 approvals. Can we add a label 'linkcheck:passed' to enforce?

ci-bot: Build 4108 - docs-preview failed: linkinator reported 12 broken anchors. Full log: https://ci.redwood.example.com/4108/logs/linkinator. doc-lint passed.

anya: I'll fix the easy anchor redirects in 4112, but some are nested anchor collisions in the nav that need manual edits (will push to 4109/4110).

jordan: For rollout, propose Tue 08:30 PT: merge 4108 (index) at 08:30, merge 4112 (redirects) at 08:40, then content PRs 09:00-09:30. We'll enable a 5% canary in fronting CDN for 1 hour. If GA docs_events > threshold or search errors spike, roll back.

lee: I'll add a smoke test script to the redirect PR:```bash
# smoke-check.sh
curl -I https://docs.redwood.example.com/reference/auth | grep 301
node ./scripts/check-anchors.js https://deploy-preview-4108--docs.redwood.example.com
```
I'll attach results in the PR.

matt: Who can watch search indexer? @search-bot can you hold off reindex until I mark GO? We don't want partial search hits.

search-bot: Acknowledged. Waiting for manual trigger. Endpoint: POST https://internal.search/redwood/reindex with body {"paths": ["/docs/rest-api"]} (auth via service token).

ci-bot: Note: protected branch rules require 2 approvals + passing CI. doc-lint and docs-preview are required checks.

anya: I'll add a migration note at top of index and a short FAQ about bookmarks. Also adding SDK snippet updates in 4111:```python
from redwood import DocsClient
client = DocsClient(base_url="https://docs.redwood.example.com/rest-api")
```

jordan: I'll take 4109 (auth) and 4110 (endpoints) reviews. matt you + anya should sign off on 4112 once redirects + smoke tests are in.

matt: Timeline confirmed. I'll announce the window in #release-war-room. Lee, merge 4112 only after you see 2 approvals and smoke test pass.

lee: Will do. Local link check command I used:```bash
# local link check
yarn docs:serve & npx linkinator "http://localhost:3000" --concurrency 4 --allowed-hosts "docs.redwood.example.com"
```

anya: One more ask: can we add a short analytics event on redirect hits so we can quantify how many bookmarked references still hit legacy URLs? A simple GA event 'docs_redirect' with old_path property.

matt: Good call. Add to redirect handler; make sure it's non-blocking. Also log to internal metrics for 48h.

ci-bot: Reminder: any PRs merged without docs-preview green will be reverted automatically by the release bot.

anya: Thanks team. I'll open a post-merge checklist: trigger search reindex, watch GA for 2h, check Sentry for any 5xx on docs paths, and confirm canonical links for SEO.

(ends)
